title: Halfmoon Packing & Outfitting, LLC

services.name: Horse Camping
services.desc: Halfmoon Packing & Outfitting offers Progressive multi night camping trips in the Holy Cross Wilderness and Mt Massive Wilderness areas. You can choose to travel between 5 and 20 miles per day. These wilderness areas are designated by Congress and limited to foot and horseback travel, no motor vehicles or bicycles to contend with here. Trips can be tailored to your desires focusing on your choice of riding, wildlife viewing, photography or fishing in Colorado. With a year of planning , at a clients request we received a special use permit from the USFS for a two week trip on the Colorado Trail. We rode from Tennessee Pass to Silverton averaging 18 miles per day while feasting on steaks,

services.name: Lake Fishing
services.desc: We offer both single and multi day fishing trips into the Holy Cross Wilderness. There is nothing quite like combining a horseback ride with a day of fishing in a glacial lake near timberline. You will depart the stables for the trail-head around 9:00 for the two hour ride to West Tennessee Lakes. Experience the best lake fishing in Colorado . During the heat of the day, while the fishing are hiding in the shadows, you can enjoy stunning panoramic views while having lunch. You could also go for a quick loop around the bowl on horseback. You should return to the stables around 4:30. The cost is $325 per person and includes lunch, beverages, and fishing gear if required. For multi day stays
